research.name: @P5-wrapper/react
research.note: React component that mounts a p5.js sketch as a canvas and passes props into the sketch.
unverified: The demo at https://p5-wrapper.github.io/react/ renders its sketches client-side into an empty #app div; without a browser I saw only the static heading and footer, not the running sketches.
The README has no screenshots or recordings, only a socialify banner image, so no visual of the output was seen in this session.
The demo sketch names (box, plane, torus, capture, record) come from the demo/sketches file listing; their source and rendered output were not inspected.
